description: Single beneficiary with MAGI exactly at the first IRMAA limit ('less than or equal to'): standard premium, no adjustment.
worked:
Premium year 2025; the income-related adjustment uses MAGI from the 2023 tax return (two years back): 106,000 (adjusted gross income plus tax-exempt interest).
CMS 2025 Medicare Parts A & B premiums fact sheet, Part B table, the individual tax return column (single, head of household, qualifying surviving spouse, married filing separately and lived apart all year): 106,000 is less than or equal to 106,000.
Part B: standard premium 185.00 + income-related adjustment 0.00 = total monthly premium 185.00.
Part D table, same row: monthly income-related adjustment 0.00 (added to the plan premium).
